# An array of unsigned int, count 40000000, and 8 bytes after it: n x s_min is 4 GiB.

type ints
breaks 5.2, point 6; 5.4, point 4.3
expect CapExceeded test.ints
offset 0
extent none
requests none
input 40000000 00000000 00000000
